experiment_data.hypothesis: The mixed-LLM 9-class AA OOD F1 collapse (0.504±0.107 at 250+250) is primarily driven by distribution heterogeneity rather than per-source data quantity insufficiency: if the collapse were quantity-driven, scaling from 250→350 per source (matching the single-source 350 Qwen-only condition) should recover AA F1 to >0.8; if heterogeneity-driven, 350+350 mixed will show persistent AA degradation (~0.5).
